kind: Declared Tibetanus chronology point sensitivity, separate from historical reproduction
source_depth_axis: Actual source Tibetanus TP rows, depth(cm), uniquely matched to native AnalysisUnit depths in cm within absolute1e-8; no interpolation/extrapolation or depth offset

chronology_profiles.source: Retained source sample ages, calibrated radiocarbon years BP, native named/default chronology38408; original bounds retained
Actual2014 Arctic supplement Tibetanus TP age(calyrBP) at each of45 directly matching native sample depths; new declared point transfer, not a replacement of native chronology38408

epoch: Native calBP follows documented Neotoma AD1950 datum. Alternative source calyrBP is interpreted on the same conventional1950 datum as an explicit point-transfer assumption, with original source label and source1995 collection-year surface kept. Never reset zero using publication/collection year.
chronology_uncertainty: Both profiles are point scenarios. No source age bounds assigned when absent; no posterior, calibration curve, fitted age model or zero-width chronology certainty. Raw11 lab controls and explicit rejected Ua10120 are comparison witnesses, not inputs refitted or automatically admitted to a chronology model.
parameter_profiles: Only the existing four explicit TIB transfer maps and parameter axes from actual4d68 report; native counts, sparse-zero and mutually-exclusive-partition assumptions unchanged
physical_response: Reuse exact actual TIB baseline factors from source-bound4d68 report, already independently qualified as part of300tuples. No physical quadrature rerun. Static100m radius,100km regional extent, wind3m/s and source empirical metre-based diffusion0.12/turbulence0.25 remain conditional geometry/protocol assumptions.
estimator: Per-core/time-window pooled mapped integer NISP; cover is closure of n_i/(PPE_i*K_i) on mapped panel. Maintained fixed_site_cover_covariance supplies counting and diagonal shared-PPE delta covariance. Missing-source zeros stay explicit hypotheses, model completeness stays separate from actual source-label masks; zero boundary SE is conditional plug-in behavior, not an absence interval.
acceptance: All45 raw samples/source-point axes authenticated, every sample included/excluded exactly once per profile, mapped+residual=NISP conserved, private actual source/point/mask support retained. Native chronology baseline must reproduce existing saved counts/windows/point/SE/covariance exactly. Alternative per-window changes retained, including disappearing/new windows; no unchanged-key-only accuracy claim.
